ctx.x: I used to go listen to all that bands where I was in the play, you know? My favorite band was Sam Morgan, though. Oh, you like that one of the bands? Oh, yeah. That's the best. That band was my band too. I can say that. I used to stand on the railroad by the station over there. They used to play right for every Monday on the pavilion right up in the station. And I used to stand up there before I'd go to dance. I'd listen to them harmonize, you know? All of Mexicoians? Oh, man, that man had the best dance music…

After Gallier he got Johnny Dave. I don't know what I mean. He might be a little young. Who? Johnny Dave, I can't remember. What's his age? Johnny Dave was a man when I was a little boy. Oh, he is? He's in the age of that guy. He's still living in the autumn gibbets. You play a band or two. I never met him.
I used to always tell us. In fact, Uncle Buddy, we used to call him Uncle Buddy. He's named Buddy Johnson. And Yank, he used to come out when Buddy couldn't come meet son Yank, I tell you see.
